text:
Anya: Hey team — quick heads-up. Cohort 7 bootcamp next week needs a mentor swap for Day 2 (Thu). Our original Mentor A had a travel emergency. Can someone cover product infra + marketplace topics 10:00–13:00 PT? Calendar: https://cal.redwood.example/cohort7
Sam G: I can take it if it's split 10:00–11:30 PT (infra) and 11:30–13:00 PT (marketplace). I'm in PST so timing works. :thumbsup:
Diego: Thanks Sam. What's the expected prep load? Any slides or lab changes?
Anya: Prep = 30–45m. Mostly walk-through of integration checklist + hands-on lab where partners register on marketplace sandbox. Slides: https://drive.redwood/example/si-bootcamp/slides. Lab repo: https://git.redwood/bootcamp/cohort7-labs
Sam G: Got it. I can tweak slides tonight. Can Ops update roster so the mentor listing shows Sam G instead of Mentor A?
Maria: @OpsBot can you swap the mentor in the roster CSV and re-run the invite job?
OpsBot: automated: roster update request received for cohort7. Processing... (job id 0x7ac).
OpsBot: automated: roster.csv row replaced. New row:
```
cohort7,2026-04-14,Day2,Sam G,sam.g@redwood.example,infra|marketplace
```
OpsBot: automated: invites re-sent to participants and mentor.
Diego: Awesome. @Sam G — can you drop 3 bullets you'd like added to the lab README so I can patch infra setup?
Sam G: Sure — will add: 1) env var names + example, 2) quick troubleshooting commands, 3) expected runtime & sample outputs. I'll post a PR to the lab repo with tags "cohort7-mentor-swap".
Jen: FYI training certs team — if the mentor change means a change in evaluation rubric ping us, otherwise we keep current scoring.
Anya: No rubric change needed. Same checklist. Just capture any deviation in the cohort notes channel.
Maria: All set from ops side. Logged change in the SI onboarding tracker: https://tasks.redwood/board/si-onboard (card #342).
Sam G: PR opened: https://git.redwood/bootcamp/cohort7-labs/pull/88 — includes README bullets and a tiny slide tweak.
Diego: Reviewed and approved. Merged. Thanks Sam. :raised_hands:
Anya: Closing loop — Sam is confirmed as Day 2 mentor. Thanks everyone for the quick turn. I'll drop a brief note to the SI contact list.
Anya: (note) If anyone else wants to swap into Day 4 morning (APAC-friendly) reply here, we may need a different timezone cover.
